title: Jacobi measure
statement: For a Boolean list $S$, let $a$ be the natural number represented by its first decoded component, and let $b$ be the natural number represented by the first decoded component of the second decoded component of $S$. The measure is the binary size of $ab$, plus $1$ if $b\le a$ and $0$ otherwise.
caveat: The decoding operations and the binary-value convention are not defined in the supplied payload, so their precise meaning cannot be confirmed.
